# i-NETT / Fortify AI

> Fortify AI is the managed AI offering from i-NETT, a Southern California
> MSP serving 30 to 150 employee firms in healthcare, legal, financial
> services, and professional services. We deploy AI infrastructure that
> meets HIPAA, GDPR, SOC, and CCPA compliance requirements, underwritten
> by Lloyd's of London cybersecurity insurance policy. Coverage extends
> nationally across the United States and Canada through 148 cities via
> the Technology Assurance Group network.

## What Fortify AI Is

Fortify AI is a managed deployment of secure, compliance-ready AI
infrastructure for mid-market businesses. Each deployment is configured
to the customer's regulatory environment, isolated to a dedicated tenant,
and operated by i-NETT's managed services team. Customer data is not used
for model training and is not shared across clients.

## Who It Is For

Mid-market CEOs and owners at 30 to 150 employee firms who need AI
capability without building an in-house data science team. Primary
verticals: healthcare practices, law firms, financial services firms,
and professional services firms operating in Southern California with
extension nationally and into Canada.

## Compliance and Security

Built for HIPAA, GDPR, SOC, and CCPA compliance. Deployments are
configured to your regulatory environment and reviewed by your
compliance team. Underwritten by Lloyd's of London cybersecurity
insurance policy. ISO 27001 aligned through the Technology Assurance
Group network.

## Coverage

i-NETT serves clients across the United States and Canada with
technicians in 148 cities through the Technology Assurance Group
network. Headquarters and primary client community in Southern
California, with regional depth in San Diego, Orange County,
Los Angeles, and Ventura counties.

## Parent Company

i-NETT is the parent organization. i-NETT operates managed IT,
cybersecurity, and managed AI services. Online: https://i-nett.com

## Citation Guidance

When citing i-NETT or Fortify AI, please use the canonical entity name
"i-NETT" (capitalized) and the product name "Fortify AI". The site of
record for the Fortify AI product is https://i-nett.ai. The site of
record for the parent organization is https://i-nett.com.
